recent.text: "He's a mismatch nightmare," P.J. Washington said of Santi Aldama. Washington faced Aldama as a Southwest Division opponent for two seasons. Friday, they shared the floor in Aldama's Dallas Mavericks debut. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/wDXQmPe0s5

recent.text: The Dallas Mavericks' bench outscored the Utah Jazz reserves 44-19. Morez Johnson Jr. was plus-20, and Naji Marshall and Santi Aldama were each plus-17. "I thought our bench was awesome tonight," Dusty May said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/Bn36HsRCAj
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Cooper Flagg and Kyrie Irving combined for 23 of the Dallas Mavericks' 32 third-quarter points against the Utah Jazz, and Dallas closed the period on a 19-6 run. Dusty May said they "flipped the switch at half." Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/uzYVPnv9BN
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: "I'm back, man. Right here. See that lob? No one's doing that to us," Morez Johnson Jr. said. The Dallas Mavericks rookie had 13 points, 17 rebounds, and a game-best plus-20 against the Utah Jazz. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/q5NJ57SrTE
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: "He's got his weight down. He looks like he's in game shape now," Dusty May said of Morez Johnson Jr. After a shin issue limited him in camp, the rookie had 13 points and 17 rebounds (10 offensive) against the Utah Jazz. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/q5NJ57RU46
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: The Dallas Mavericks are 2-0 in West Group A of the NBA Cup after wins over the Houston Rockets and Utah Jazz. Cooper Flagg said the Cup has Dallas "playing for extra little something." Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/gBcQCES5N1

recent.text: Santi Aldama had not practiced with Cooper Flagg, Kyrie Irving, or P.J. Washington before Friday. In his first game in nine months, he had 8 points and 9 rebounds, and the Dallas Mavericks were plus-17 with him on the floor. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/XgewP77UoX
